summary: SupervisorMessages is a user control used in a Welcome screen for supervisors within the HSPnet web application. It manages supervisor-specific messaging, session state initialization, display of assessments and alerts, and navigation to related details and summaries.
purpose: To provide supervisors with an overview of recent changes, assessments, and alerts relevant to their role. The control initializes session variables, displays assessments filtered by 'Supervisor', shows statistics on changes, and dynamically renders help/news content. It facilitates navigation to detailed views and supports workflows for assessment management and review.

workflows.name: Supervisor Welcome Screen Initialization
steps: On first load, set critical session variables (agency, date ranges, last welcome screen, filter keys).
Call SetupChangesMadeByOthers to configure filters and statistics for recent changes.
Call SetupAssessments to bind assessment data filtered by 'Supervisor' and staff ID.
Call SetupNews to fetch and display help/news content for supervisors.

workflows.name: Assessment Row Rendering
steps: For each assessment row, check if the student/destination matches the last rendered; hide repeated fields.
Setup hyperlinks for navigating to student details or assessment details as per session and data values.
Render progress and status indicators based on assessment properties.
Customize visibility and navigation of controls according to assessor type and assessment state.

workflows.name: Change Statistics Workflow
steps: Invoke PlacementStatistics.PlacementChangeStatisticsSupervisor to get changes relevant to the supervisor.
Bind statistics to the FormView; display only items with relevant changes.
Setup navigation to various summary screens (alerts added, canceled, date changed, destinations changed, supervisors added/changed) via hyperlinks.

business_rules: Session variables must be initialized on first login to avoid preview crashes.
Assessments displayed are filtered by staff ID and the 'Supervisor' role.
Assessment rows with repeated student/destination combinations hide redundant fields.
Navigation to detailed screens uses hashed URLs for security.
Visibility of some UI panels is determined by agency activation status (though overridden to always visible).
Help/news content is dynamically styled and only visible if there is help text.
validations: Only show assessment row controls if student/destination is not duplicated.
Hyperlinks are visible only when data status and dates permit viewing.
Help/news panels hidden if help text is blank.
Show change statistics only where counts are positive.
calculations: PlacementStatisticsDC properties (AlertsAdded, PACancelled, DateChanged, PADestAddedChanged, SupervisorsAddedChanged) are used to determine visibility and summary counts.
Assessment progress and status indicators are set using PlacementRequestAssessments.SetupProgressIcon.
Assessment date and status calculations determine open/closed states and hyperlink visibility.
conditions: First login triggers session variable initialization.
Assessment row controls hidden for repeated students/destinations.
Hyperlinks for details are only active for certain assessment states and date ranges.
Help/news content is styled if color codes are embedded in the title/text.
system_behavior: Initializes session on first load to ensure consistent downstream workflow.
Displays assessments, statistics, help/news, and navigational controls based on user/session/context.
Handles row commands for details in assessments, highlighting clicked rows.
Renders UI panels, controls, and interactions as per business logic and session state.
dependencies: UserSession and session variables for context and filtering.
PlacementRequestAssessments and PlacementStatistics for data sources.
exceptions: If session variables are not set, downstream preview screens may crash.
If help/news content is blank, alert boxes are hidden.
If assessment status/dates are not valid, hyperlinks and controls are not visible.
